n.story:
Your role is being augmented by a 'digital nervous system' that processes the chaos of the battlefield into actionable intelligence. While the physical demands and moral weight of leadership remain unchanged, your situational awareness is reaching unprecedented levels. AI now handles the heavy lifting of monitoring surveillance feeds, decrypting signals, and enforcing information security policies, freeing you from the cognitive load of raw data processing during high-stakes operations.

In the planning phase, you will use AI to simulate millions of tactical scenarios, identifying hidden threats and optimal routes that would be invisible to the human eye. However, the 'human in the loop' becomes more critical than ever; AI can suggest tactics, but only you can weigh the ethical, political, and human costs of a mission. Your evolution is from a traditional commander to a tech-augmented strategist who blends machine precision with human empathy and intuition.

While the core of your job remains grounded in physical presence and the moral weight of leadership, the fog of war is being lifted by AI. You no longer spend hours manually decoding signals or tracking equipment logs; instead, you manage a digital ecosystem that provides real-time predictive analytics on enemy movements and weapon effectiveness.
